newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore land tender draws top bid of S$682.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Singapore land tender draws top bid of S$682.8 mln.

text.p: The Urban Redevelopment Authority of Singapore said on Wednesday that Japura Pte Ltd had bid the highest -- Singapore $682.8 million -- for a 39,701.7 square metre site in the city state's east.
The land, in Bayshore Road, is slated for condominium development.
Goodland Pte Ltd bid the highest for a 21,381 sq metre plot, also in eastern Singapore, at S$17.95 million. This priced it at S$839.53 per sq metre.
The land at Saraca Road is for mixed housing.
